relationships.subject: anti-CGRP antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Anti-CGRP (ligand or receptor) monoclonals lead to improvement of depressive symptoms in individuals with migraine, independent of migraine reduction.

relationships.subject: anti-CGRP antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Reduction in HADS‐D was positively associated with MMD reduction (β = 0.18, p < 0.001), but treatment with anti‐CGRP medication had an additional effect on the reduction in HADS‐D

key_findings: Anti-CGRP treatment reduced HADS-D depression scores independent of migraine day reduction.
Active depression predicted poorer response to erenumab but not fremanezumab.
